description: Frozen CLIP supplies five layers of patch and whole-image features. Separate trained heads score normal versus anomalous at each layer. No target reference is used.
hypothesis_question: How well does the original learned detector transfer without target references?
comparison_explanation: Anchor for inference additions; compare supplied paper targets separately.
short_comment: Zero-shot anchor; compare paper targets cautiously.

description: Reuse baseline; for each query patch find its five most similar patches elsewhere in that same image, excluding the radius-3 neighborhood. Poor similarity gives a high self-score. Fuse 20% self-map with 80% baseline map.
hypothesis_question: Does lack of a similar distant patch within the query reveal defects?
comparison_explanation: Compare baseline; same weights and no extra images, but fused-map image-score pooling also changes.
short_comment: P-AUPR lower than baseline by 0.89 pp; 0/3 seeds improve. Dataset-dependent benefit.

description: Train the original baseline heads with CAA image stitching disabled but crop CAA retained. This controls for the augmentation change required by residual models.
hypothesis_question: How much does disabling training image stitching change the baseline?
comparison_explanation: Compare baseline to measure the augmentation change alone.
short_comment: P-AUPR lower than baseline by 0.36 pp; 0/3 seeds improve.

description: Train extra heads at layers 12/15 on (patch minus near average) divided by patch feature length. Near is a 5x5 square excluding center. Average original and residual probabilities at those layers.
hypothesis_question: Does learning immediate-neighborhood disagreement improve the matched control?
comparison_explanation: Compare residual_control to hold the training augmentation policy fixed.
short_comment: P-AUPR lower than residual_control by 2.17 pp; 0/3 seeds improve. No residual gain over matched no-mosaic control.

description: Train near and mid residual heads at all five layers. Mid averages the 13x13 square outside its central 5x5 square. Each layer averages original, near, and mid probabilities; changes both ranges and layer coverage versus b_near.
hypothesis_question: Does a larger model with near and middle context improve the matched control?
comparison_explanation: Compare residual_control; b_near to c_mid also changes the number of layers with added heads.
short_comment: P-AUPR lower than residual_control by 4.86 pp; 0/3 seeds improve. No residual gain over matched no-mosaic control.

description: Add a whole-image-average residual branch to c_mid. Each of five layers averages four probabilities: original appearance, near residual, mid residual, and global residual. Each residual range has separate learned weights.
hypothesis_question: Does adding whole-image context help beyond near and middle context?
comparison_explanation: Compare c_mid for the added global branch, and residual_control for overall usefulness.
short_comment: P-AUPR lower than residual_control by 2.86 pp; 0/3 seeds improve. No residual gain over matched no-mosaic control.

description: Use the same three residual ranges as d_global, but share residual weights, scale, and bias across ranges within each layer. Original appearance heads and heads at different layers remain separate.
hypothesis_question: Do separate classifiers per context range help more than shared classifiers?
comparison_explanation: Compare d_global for shared versus separate range weights, and residual_control for overall usefulness.
short_comment: P-AUPR higher than d_global by 0.70 pp; 3/3 seeds improve. Sharing helps P-AUPR here; below matched control.

description: Reuse baseline and store patch features from one normal target image per category/view. Each query patch finds its best appearance match anywhere in that reference; fuse 50% memory distance with 50% baseline map.
hypothesis_question: How much does one good target example plus appearance matching help?
comparison_explanation: Compare baseline, recognizing that the method now receives target normal data.
short_comment: P-AUPR higher than baseline by 8.70 pp; 3/3 seeds improve. Adds normal target references; different supervision from zero-shot.

description: Use the same normal references as appearance memory, but concatenate normalized appearance, near difference, and mid difference into one descriptor with weights 1:sqrt(0.5):sqrt(0.5). Find one joint best match; retain 50/50 map fusion.
hypothesis_question: Does matching appearance and surroundings jointly beat appearance matching at the same shot count?
comparison_explanation: Compare memory_appearance; same reference selection, shot count, and map fusion.
short_comment: P-AUPR higher than memory_appearance by 2.00 pp; 3/3 seeds improve.

description: Use the contextual memory descriptor, but allow reference matches only within eight patch rows and columns of the query position. Tests whether restricting matches by approximate spatial alignment helps.
hypothesis_question: Does restricting contextual matches to approximately corresponding positions help?
comparison_explanation: Compare memory_context; only the spatial candidate restriction is added.
short_comment: P-AUPR lower than memory_context by 1.16 pp; 0/3 seeds improve.

description: Repeat ordinary baseline inference with the same checkpoint and settings. There is no mosaic or additional reference; this is the original control result.
hypothesis_question: What is the unchanged baseline result for the mosaic comparisons?
comparison_explanation: Same result as baseline; not an independent replicate.
short_comment: Duplicate baseline result; not an independent replicate.

description: Place query plus three copies of one known-normal target reference in a fixed 518x518 canvas. Reuse baseline, crop query heatmap, and average four query-corner positions. Reference enters as pixels, not memory matching.
hypothesis_question: Does showing the encoder a normal reference beside the query improve detection?
comparison_explanation: Compare baseline for total change, mosaic_random for known-normal companions, and mosaic_query for an external-image control.
short_comment: P-AUPR higher than baseline by 4.65 pp; 3/3 seeds improve.

description: Use the same canvas and four-corner averaging as normal mosaic, but companions repeat one unverified test image of the same category/view. Tests whether known-normal status matters; may include anomalies or the query itself.
hypothesis_question: Must a companion image be known normal for a mosaic to help?
comparison_explanation: Compare mosaic_normal; companion source changes from known-normal training image to unverified test image.
short_comment: P-AUPR higher than baseline by 3.74 pp; 3/3 seeds improve. Transductive control; labels not checked for reference selection.

description: Fill all four canvas tiles with the query itself, reuse baseline, crop query heatmaps, and average four corner positions. Controls for duplication and canvas processing without an external image.
hypothesis_question: Does query duplication alone produce the mosaic improvement?
comparison_explanation: Compare mosaic_normal and baseline; all mosaic runs change tile resolution and use four inference passes.
short_comment: P-AUPR lower than baseline by 5.21 pp; 0/3 seeds improve.
